scenario_text:
Catalyst Node Name: chem_e_3
Catalyst Name: E-3
  Composition:
    P: 2.2 wt%
    Pt: 0.3 wt%
    Zn: 4.7 wt%
  Properties:
    pore volume: 0.23 mL/g
    specific surface area: 198 m2/g

Synthesis Pathway:

  Step 1: EUO molecular sieve preparation (ID: synth_step_1)
    Procedure: 本发明所用 EUO分子筛是按照美国专利US6733658 实施例 3 的方法制备,得到的分子筛硅铝摩尔比为63,比表面积449m2/,孔容0.19mL/g。
    Outputs:
      - EUO分子筛
        Properties:
          micropore channel structure: 一维微孔孔道结构 description
          pore volume: 0.19 mL/g
          silicon-to-aluminum molar ratio: 63 molar ratio
          specific surface area: 449 m2/g
          ten-membered ring straight channel size: 0.58×0.41 nm
          twelve-membered ring side pocket size: 0.68×0.58×0.81 nm

  Step 2: Ammonium exchange and calcination (ID: synth_step_2)
    Procedure: 上述合成的沸石含有碱金属或碱土金属的阳离子,与铵阳离子进行交换,随后经过316℃~540℃的空气中焙烧 1~10小时,此种形成酸性沸石是本领域中熟知的。
    Inputs:
      - EUO分子筛 (reactant)
        Properties:
          micropore channel structure: 一维微孔孔道结构 description
          pore volume: 0.19 mL/g
          silicon-to-aluminum molar ratio: 63 molar ratio
          specific surface area: 449 m2/g
          ten-membered ring straight channel size: 0.58×0.41 nm
          twelve-membered ring side pocket size: 0.68×0.58×0.81 nm
      - 铵阳离子 (reagent)
    Outputs:
      - 酸性EUO分子筛
    Conditions:
      atmosphere: 空气 atmosphere
      calcination_temperature: 316~540 ℃
      calcination_time: 1~10 h

  Step 3: Carrier S-1 extrusion (ID: synth_step_3)
    Procedure: 将步骤(1)所得的酸性EUO分子筛、氧化铝粉充分混合,加入66wt%的硝酸混捏成可塑的膏状物,挤成直径为 1.5mm 的圆柱条,经过110℃干燥8h,然后在空气气氛中550℃焙烧6h,制得直径为 1.35mm 的载体记做 S-1,其中载体中分子筛的含量为60wt%,余量为氧化铝。
    Inputs:
      - 66wt%的硝酸 (reagent)
        Composition:
          HNO3: 66 wt%
      - 氧化铝粉 (Additive)
      - 酸性EUO分子筛 (reactant)
    Outputs:
      - S-1
        Composition:
          Al2O3: 余量 balance
          molecular sieve: 60 wt%
        Properties:
          diameter: 1.35 mm
    Conditions:
      atmosphere: 空气 atmosphere
      calcination_temperature: 550 ℃
      calcination_time: 6 h
      drying_temperature: 110 ℃
      drying_time: 8 h
      extrudate_diameter: 1.5 mm

  Step 4: E-3 co-impregnation (ID: synth_step_9)
    Procedure: 取200克 S-1 载体,使用含有氯铂酸、硝酸锌和磷酸的溶液饱和浸渍催化剂载体,然后再150℃干燥4小时,在空气气氛中540℃焙烧 2h,制得含 0.3wt% Pt、4.7wt% Zn 和 2.2wt% P的本发明催化剂,编号为 E-3。
    Inputs:
      - H2PtC16 (reagent)
      - S-1 (reactant)
        Composition:
          Al2O3: 余量 balance
          molecular sieve: 60 wt%
        Properties:
          diameter: 1.35 mm
      - 硝酸锌 (reagent)
      - 磷酸 (Additive)
    Outputs:
      - E-3
        Composition:
          P: 2.2 wt%
          Pt: 0.3 wt%
          Zn: 4.7 wt%
        Properties:
          pore volume: 0.23 mL/g
          specific surface area: 198 m2/g
    Conditions:
      atmosphere: 空气 atmosphere
      calcination_temperature: 540 ℃
      calcination_time: 2 h
      carrier_amount: 200 g
      drying_temperature: 150 ℃
      drying_time: 4 h

Testing Scenarios:

  Scenario 1: C8 aromatic isomerization and ethylbenzene conversion test for E-3 at 390°C (ID: test_6)
    Conditions:
      WHSV: 20 h^-1
      catalyst_volume: 100 mL
      ethylbenzene_in_feed: 7.9 vol%
      experimental_setup: 中试装置 descriptive
      hydrogen_to_hydrocarbon_molar_ratio: 2:1 molar ratio
      meta_xylene_in_feed: 70.2 vol%
      ortho_xylene_in_feed: 21.8 vol%
      para_xylene_in_feed: 0.1 vol%
      pretreatment_atmosphere: 氢气 gas atmosphere
      pretreatment_temperature: 653 K
      pretreatment_time: 4 h
      quartz_sand_dilution_volume: 100 mL
      reaction_pressure: 1.0 MPa
      reaction_temperature: 390 °C
    Results:
      ethylbenzene_conversion: 44.1 %
      para_xylene_fraction_in_total_xylene: 23.8 %
      xylene_loss: 1.3 %

Characterization:

  Characterization 1: N2 adsorption (ID: char_6)
    Data reported: True
    Summary: Low-temperature N2 adsorption shows catalyst E-3 has a surface area of 198 m2/g and a pore volume of 0.23 ml/g.
    Evidence: 本发明催化剂的理化性质如下:比表面为80~150m2/g,孔容为 0.25~0.60ml/g(采用 ASAP2400 低温氮吸附仪测得比表面和孔容) ... E-3|0.3|-|4.7|2.2|198|0.23
